findings.evidence: Positivity.lean:74 `variable {Hadron Flavor : Type} (ρ : Hadron → Flavor → ℝ → ℝ → SpinDensityC)` vs Parton/PDF/Positivity.lean:250 `def pdfOfSpinDensity (ρ : Flavor → ℝ → ℝ → SpinDensity) : Pdf Flavor`. The `C` marker is the file-local convention for the complex type throughout SpinDensityC.lean: `SpinDensity.toSpinDensityC` (428), `mat_toSpinDensityC` (437), `f1_toSpinDensityC` (446), `isParityInvariant_toSpinDensityC_iff` (469). Mathlib naming guide: `_`-separated strings in a lemma name should correspond to a definition name.
findings.fix: Rename to `fragOfSpinDensityC`, `helicityFragOfSpinDensityC`, `transversityFragOfSpinDensityC`, and the derived names accordingly: `fragOfSpinDensityC_apply` (94), `helicityFragOfSpinDensityC_apply` (98), `transversityFragOfSpinDensityC_apply` (102), `fragOfSpinDensityC_nonneg` (113), `assumptions_fragOfSpinDensityC_iff` (141), `helicityFragOfSpinDensityC_eq_zero_of_notMem_unitInterval` (152), `transversityFragOfSpinDensityC_eq_zero_of_notMem_unitInterval` (159), updating the module docstring references at lines 29-48.
findings.issue: `fragOfSpinDensity`, `helicityFragOfSpinDensity`, `transversityFragOfSpinDensity` (lines 80, 85, 90) take `ρ : Hadron → Flavor → ℝ → ℝ → SpinDensityC`, but the name says `SpinDensity`, which is a different, real type in the same project. The sibling declarations `PDF.pdfOfSpinDensity` / `helicityPdfOfSpinDensity` / `transversityPdfOfSpinDensity` (Parton/PDF/Positivity.lean:250,256,261) take `Flavor → ℝ → ℝ → SpinDensity`, the real one — so the `OfSpinDensity` suffix already means the real matrix here. The mismatch also mispredicts the value type: `transversityPdfOfSpinDensity : Pdf` is real, while `transversityFragOfSpinDensity` is ℂ-valued precisely because the input is complex.

summary: Names and the absence of notation are otherwise fine, but the new fragmentation definitions are suffixed `OfSpinDensity` while their argument is `SpinDensityC`, contradicting the established in-repo convention where `...OfSpinDensity` takes the real `SpinDensity` and the complex type is always marked with `C`.
